description: Surface workflow artifact chips on completed task rows and render markdown artifacts with an improved ArtifactContentViewer header (size, copy feedback).

tasks.title: Extract shared MarkdownContent component
tasks.description: Move the inline MarkdownContent renderer from IssueDetailPage.tsx (lines 100-125) into a shared module at packages/web/src/shared/ui/components/markdown-content.tsx and update IssueDetailPage.tsx to import and use it. Preserve the existing react-markdown + remarkGfm setup, inline-code styling, and code-block styling exactly so issue descriptions continue to render the same way.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared MarkdownContent component exists and exports a renderer using react-markdown with remarkGfm
IssueDetailPage.tsx imports and uses the shared component with no visual or behavioral regression
Component is importable by ArtifactContentViewer in a later task
tasks.notes: Move the component verbatim; do not change props or default styling.

tasks.title: Render artifact chips on completed task rows
tasks.description: Update WorkflowView.tsx/TaskItem so completed tasks with artifactSummaries render clickable TaskArtifactSummaryChip pills directly on the task row, positioned between the task title and the duration. Tasks that are not completed or have empty artifactSummaries render no chips. Reuse the existing chip component, styling, file/directory icons, and click handler. Add or update tests in WorkflowView.test.tsx to verify visibility rules and click behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Completed tasks with artifactSummaries show one chip per summary on the task row
Chips appear between the task title and the duration
Incomplete tasks and tasks without artifactSummaries show no chips
Clicking a chip opens the ArtifactContentViewer dialog for the selected artifact
Tests cover completed-with-artifacts, incomplete, and no-artifacts cases
tasks.notes: Reuse TaskArtifactSummaryChip; gate rendering with task.status === 'completed' && artifactSummaries.length > 0.

tasks.title: Render markdown artifacts in ArtifactContentViewer
tasks.description: Update ArtifactContentViewer.tsx to detect markdown artifacts by path extension (.md or .markdown, case-insensitive). For markdown paths, render content using the shared MarkdownContent component. For non-markdown text artifacts, keep the existing <pre className='font-mono'> rendering. Preserve directory browsing and artifact-history behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: .md and .markdown artifacts render as formatted markdown with headings, lists, code blocks, and tables
Code blocks retain syntax highlighting via the shared MarkdownContent styling
Non-markdown text artifacts (e.g., .json, .yaml, .txt) render as monospaced <pre> text
Raw markdown source is no longer shown for markdown files
Directory browsing and history navigation remain intact

tasks.title: Show artifact size in viewer header
tasks.description: Extend the ArtifactContentViewer header to display size information. For file artifacts, show the artifact name or path alongside its formatted size. For directory artifacts, show the directory name with total file count and formatted totalSize. Use the existing formatBytes helper. Preserve existing directory browsing so selecting an entry still shows the entry path and size breadcrumb.
acceptanceCriteria: File artifact header shows artifact name/path and formatted size
Directory artifact header shows directory name, total file count, and formatted total size
Browsing a file inside a directory still displays the entry path and size breadcrumb
Existing directory browsing behavior remains functional
tasks.notes: Continue using the existing formatBytes helper already present in ArtifactContentViewer.tsx.

tasks.title: Add copy feedback to ArtifactContentViewer
tasks.description: Add a copy button to the ArtifactContentViewer header or content area. When clicked, copy the artifact text content to the clipboard using navigator.clipboard.writeText and render a transient 'Copied' indicator that clears after ~2 seconds or when the viewer closes. Gracefully degrade when the clipboard API is unavailable (e.g., insecure contexts) by showing a fallback message such as 'Unable to copy'.
acceptanceCriteria: Copy button is visible when viewing file text content
Clicking copy writes artifact content to the clipboard
A 'Copied' indicator appears after successful copy and clears automatically
Clipboard failures are handled gracefully with a non-blocking fallback message
Directory listing views do not require a copy button
tasks.notes: Place the button near the header for discoverability; transient state clears on close and timeout.
